Hand-sheet shapes classified by data-kind: road/river/revetment ways at 500; an explicit ground list (courts, gardens, practice ground, cart yard, pines, shrine grove, river landing) and the full-view background rect free; every other kind, court divider, weighing floor and every other - shape (the scale bar) included, an obstacle; every <text> an obstacle
decisions.why: Round-3 item RESOLVED: weighing floor is off the ground list and named an obstacle (plan line 118). Aside RESOLVED: only the - rect covering the whole view is free (checked 2026-09-27, grep: each tagged sheet has one 0,0 full-canvas background rect, e.g. ubame 1300x900 over viewBox 176 84 1054 744; the - group at ubame line 79 is the scale bar, now an obstacle). What remains free is ground cover and area fill, which FR-006 weighs 0, so the mapping is FR-006 literally rather than a narrowing.

With that reach it enforces FR-013 hold every hand-drawn sheet and narrows nothing.
